clips.title: The story
paras: Warsong Lumber Camp cuts timber from Ashenvale for the Horde, keeping its conflict with the night elves alive. Kargathia Keep anchors the fortified operation.

Warsong Lumber Camp cuts into eastern Ashenvale's dense canopy for the Horde. Orc peons and hired goblin engineers use whirring shredders to turn towering trunks into lumber for nearby Splintertree Post and the fledgling nation of Durotar. Kargathia Keep's stockades anchor the defenses against night elf counterattacks, and the camp keeps war wolves in an active kennel. For the Warsong, each felled tree means survival and strength. For the native Sentinels, each saw blade is an act of sacrilege.

Warsong clan warriors first entered these woods with Grom Hellscream during the Third War, seeking timber for the Horde. Their clearing of the forest enraged the demigod Cenarius and drew the ancient wrath of the night elves. The camp now flies the banners of Thrall's Horde, but old hatreds still burn. Untamed timber, hostile elves, and demonic corruption around neighboring Felfire Hill surround the camp. Its defenders stay armed around the clock, axes in hand as they harvest, ready to abandon their timber when the next ambush comes.
